en: The image is an old, hand-tinted postcard depicting the front facade of a large church with a rose window and ornate entrance, topped by a cross. To the left stands a tall bell tower with a red roof. Several people in early 20th-century attire are seen walking and standing in the open square in front of the church. The postcard has a vintage style, suggesting it is from the early 1900s.
